item.text: The attendance increased from 20 to 30, a gain of 10 people. Since the original number was 20, the percentage increase was \(10/20 \times 100 = 50\%\). It then decreased from 30 to 20, again a change of 10 people. However, the decrease is measured against the new starting number, 30, so it equals \(10/30 \times 100 \approx 33.3\%\). The percentages differ because percentage changes use different reference values.
